ui.privH: Your files never leave your device
ui.privPnf: Everything you type is calculated by JavaScript in this tab. Nothing is sent to {brand} or anyone else, and there are no accounts or tracking cookies tied to what you enter.
ui.privP: {tool} runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. Your files are read from your disk into this tab, processed in memory and saved straight back to your downloads folder – they are never uploaded to {brand} or any third party.
ui.privL1: once this page has loaded, switch off Wi‑Fi or mobile data and run the tool – it keeps working.
ui.privL2: open your browser’s developer tools (F12 → Network) while processing; you will see no file upload requests.
ui.privL3: close the tab and the data is gone – there is no server copy, no retention period and no account.
